QUOTE: "The effect is that plain `ctx->m` fails to compile for anyone outside the library. The name is the only thing that changes. The layout does not, so the mangling is not an ABI change."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that compile-time failure comes from renaming the member to `private_m`, and that the layout is unchanged, which matches the item. It doesn't say the fields stay visible and sized, but unchanged layout implies that.
